definitions.gloss: cherry blossom blizzard, shower of cherry petals
definitions.explanation: The spectacle of cherry blossom petals falling thickly through the air, resembling a snowstorm. A poetic image of late spring when the blossoms scatter.

examples.japanese: {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The shower of cherry petals is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧。
examples.english: The wind blew and cherry petals swirled up into the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}{並木|なみき}→桜並木：13123_sakuranamiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: While walking along the row of cherry trees in the park, I was enveloped in a magnificent shower of petals.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossom) and ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧ (blizzard, snowstorm). This poetic image compares the dense fluttering of fallen cherry petals to a snowstorm. It describes the period just after full bloom when petals begin to scatter (⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧). Commonly evoked in literature, song lyrics, and seasonal descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: cherry petals dance/flutter
- {桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in cherry petals
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{桜吹雪|さくらふぶき}: a magnificent petal shower
